# 🚗 Used Car Price Prediction Using Machine Learning

## Project Overview

This project develops a machine learning system to predict used car prices based on vehicle characteristics.

## Machine Learning Algorithms

Implemented models:

- Linear Regression
- Ridge Regression
- Lasso Regression
- Decision Tree Regressor
- Random Forest Regressor
- Gradient Boosting
- Support Vector Regression
- XGBoost
- Extra Trees
- AdaBoost
- CatBoost
- LightGBM


## Workflow

1. Data Cleaning
2. Exploratory Data Analysis
3. Feature Engineering
4. Model Training
5. Model Evaluation
6. Hyperparameter Optimization
7. Deployment


## Technologies Used

- Python
- Pandas
- NumPy
- Scikit-learn
- XGBoost
- CatBoost
- LightGBM
- Streamlit


## Application

The trained model is deployed as an interactive Streamlit web application.

Users can enter vehicle details and receive predicted prices instantly.
